benchmark_type_evidence: SEA-HELM is a curated suite of SEA datasets which are evaluated together... SEA-HELM (a) incorporates natively adapted and human-translated benchmark tasks from a range of SEA languages... (b) created the human-translated SEA-IFEval and SEA-MTBench datasets; and (c) constructed LLM prompt templates in each native language... SEA-HELM includes new datasets we developed for granular linguistic diagnostics (LINDSEA)
brief_description: SEA-HELM (SouthEast Asian Holistic Evaluation of Language Models) is a holistic multilingual and multicultural LLM evaluation suite for Southeast Asian languages, comprising five core pillars: NLP Classics, LLM-Specifics, SEA Linguistics, SEA Culture, and Safety. It currently supports Filipino, Indonesian, Tamil, Thai, and Vietnamese, combining collated native-language and translated datasets with newly created benchmarks (SEA-IFEval, SEA-MTBench, LINDSEA).
